    SELECT MAX("NU_ANO") AS ano FROM socioeconomico WHERE "QT_POPULACAO" IS NOT NULL
)
SELECT mu."NO_MUNICIPIO" AS municipio_maior_populacao,
       s."QT_POPULACAO" AS total_habitantes
FROM socioeconomico s
JOIN latest_year ly ON s."NU_ANO" = ly.ano
JOIN municipios mu ON s."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D"
WHERE s."QT_POPULACAO" IS NOT NULL
ORDER BY s."QT_POPULACAO" DESC

    FROM internacoes i
    JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D"
    WHERE mu."SG_UF" = 'RS'
), por_municipio AS (
    SELECT mu."NO_MUNICIPIO" AS nome,
           COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes,
           ROUND(SUM(CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) * 100.0 / COUNT(*), 2) AS taxa_mortalidade

    JOIN municipios mu ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mu."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D"

)

items.sql: WITH base AS (SELECT mr."SG_UF" AS uf_residencia, mh."SG_UF" AS uf_hospital FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios mr ON i."MUNIC_RES" = mr."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" JOIN hospital h ON i."CNES" = h."CNES" JOIN municipios mh ON h."MUNIC_MOV" = mh."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE regexp_full_match(mr."SG_UF", '^[A-Z]{2}$') AND regexp_full_match(mh."SG_UF", '^[A-Z]{2}$')) SELECT uf_residencia, uf_hospital, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM base WHERE uf_residencia <> uf_hospital GROUP BY uf_residencia, uf_hospital ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: Qual o custo medio por dia calendario de internacao por especialidade e desfecho de morte?
items.sql:
SELECT e."DESCRICAO" AS especialidade,
       CASE WHEN i."MORTE" = true THEN 'obito' ELSE 'sem_obito' END AS desfecho,
       COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes,
       ROUND(AVG(i."VAL_TOT" / NULLIF(date_diff('day', i."DT_INTER", i."DT_SAIDA") + 1, 0)), 2) AS custo_medio_por_dia_calendario
FROM internacoes i
JOIN especialidade e ON i."ESPEC" = e."ESPEC"
WHERE i."VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL
  AND i."DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL
  AND i."DT_SAIDA" IS NOT NULL
  AND date_diff('day', i."DT_INTER", i."DT_SAIDA") >= 0
GROUP BY e."DESCRICAO", desfecho
HAVING COUNT(*) > 1000
ORDER BY custo_medio_por_dia_calendario DESC
LIMIT 20

items.question: Qual percentual de internacoes possui diagnostico secundario preenchido por ano e por desfecho?
items.sql: WITH agg AS (SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, CASE WHEN "MORTE" = true THEN 'obito' ELSE 'sem_obito' END AS desfecho, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes, SUM(CASE WHEN "DIAG_SECUN" IS NOT NULL AND "DIAG_SECUN" <> '' THEN 1 ELSE 0 END) AS com_diag_secundario FROM internacoes WHERE "DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL GROUP BY ano, desfecho) SELECT ano, desfecho, total_internacoes, com_diag_secundario, ROUND(com_diag_secundario * 100.0 / NULLIF(total_internacoes, 0), 2) AS percentual_com_diag_secundario FROM agg ORDER BY ano, desfecho

items.question: Quantos registros com idade zero parecem inconsistentes com data de nascimento e data de internacao por ano?
items.sql: SELECT EXTRACT(YEAR FROM "DT_INTER") AS ano, COUNT(*) AS idade_zero_inconsistente FROM internacoes WHERE "IDADE" = 0 AND "NASC" IS NOT NULL AND "DT_INTER" IS NOT NULL AND date_diff('day', "NASC", "DT_INTER") >= 365 GROUP BY ano ORDER BY ano

items.question: Quais codigos de municipio de residencia sem correspondencia aparecem com maior volume de internacoes?
items.sql: SELECT i."MUNIC_RES" AS codigo_municipio_residencia, COUNT(*) AS total_internacoes FROM internacoes i LEFT JOIN municipios m ON i."MUNIC_RES" = m."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" WHERE i."MUNIC_RES" IS NOT NULL AND m."CO_MUNICIPIO_6D" IS NULL GROUP BY i."MUNIC_RES" ORDER BY total_internacoes DESC LIMIT 10

items.question: Quais capitulos CID concentram mais internacoes de alto custo acima do percentil 99 do valor total?
items.sql: WITH limite AS (SELECT QUANTILE_CONT("VAL_TOT", 0.99) AS p99_valor FROM internacoes WHERE "VAL_TOT" IS NOT NULL), alto_custo AS (SELECT i."DIAG_PRINC", i."VAL_TOT" FROM internacoes i, limite l WHERE i."VAL_TOT" > l.p99_valor) SELECT c."DS_CAPITULO" AS capitulo_cid, COUNT(*) AS internacoes_alto_custo, ROUND(SUM(a."VAL_TOT"), 2) AS custo_total_alto_custo FROM alto_custo a JOIN cid c ON a."DIAG_PRINC" = c."CID" GROUP BY c."DS_CAPITULO" ORDER BY internacoes_alto_custo DESC LIMIT 10
